original_description:
Organic Dry Amla – 100g | Traditional Indian Gooseberry for Daily Wellness

Experience the timeless essence of Phyllanthus emblica—known in Ayurveda as Amla—in its pure, sun-dried form. Sourced from organic farms across India, our Dry Amla is carefully handpicked and naturally air-dried to preserve its traditional character and earthy tang.

A staple in Ayurvedic households for generations, Dry Amla is valued for its distinctive flavor and versatility. Enjoy it as a wholesome snack, add it to chutneys, teas, or herbal preparations, or incorporate it into your daily ritual for a touch of nature’s balance.

Rich in natural fiber and traditional botanical essence, Dry Amla complements a mindful lifestyle and supports the body’s natural rhythms. Its gentle tartness makes it a beloved ingredient in age-old culinary and wellness traditions.

Perfect for those who appreciate authentic, minimally processed botanicals. Store in a cool, dry place. Best enjoyed as part of a balanced routine.

100% Pure. No Additives. No Preservatives.
